tools.name: google_maps_directions
tools.description: Get directions between two points via SerpAPI. Provide a start point (one of start_addr, start_coords 'lat,lon', or start_data_id) and an end point (one of end_addr, end_coords, or end_data_id) — the data_ids come from google_maps_search results. Returns the route(s) with distance, duration and step
